name: Core infill: unmodelled OS buildings in the core area
source: Author-supplied london_buildings_1891-96_corr_v1.gpkg (project extract west-ham-buffer-buildings-bng.geojson.gz); cached NLS OS London five-foot mosaic (os-london-five-foot-1893)
sourceCRS: EPSG:27700 to scene origin E538900,N183209; x east, z south, metres
method: Audit of london_buildings_1891-96_corr_v1.gpkg against every scene building outline (factory ranges and holders, ground-plan terraces, houses, mapped factories and holders, High Street frontages, housing rows with extensions and privies, the south-west rows, the Abbey Mills station plan, and the tanks, chimneys, kilns and purifier banks drawn as structures), 1 m tolerance: footprints of 30 m² and over with under 10% of their area modelled. Sites from the author's Industry_1893-95 polygons (site id = feature index, as in factory-buildings.json); other buildings are grouped by nearest street into context sites 92xx (model groupings, not parcels). Storeys, materials and uses are typological estimates by size and position (no Goad reading): factory sites under 60 m² a one-storey timber shed, 60-250 m² a one-storey brick outbuilding, 250 m² and over a two-storey brick range; elsewhere within 8 m of a street and under 200 m² a two-storey brick house or shop, under 60 m² a timber shed, otherwise a one-storey brick building. Those of 300 m² and over are flagged for individual reading (OS, Goad where a sheet exists). Footprints that an earlier review already decided (classified outlines, excluded context, reviewed domestic outlines, chimney bases) are held back. Each kept outline is clipped 0.15 m clear of the existing scene buildings, so no reviewed range is trimmed; the reviewed sites' own checks pin their reviewed ranges and leave these infill ranges to this register. Non-factory outlines within 20 m of the OS-traced housing rows (housing-detail.json) are excluded with the housing districts, and outlines over 2 m² inside a drawn road corridor are held back.
